pivots.from: Running clinical trials with AI (YC description)
pivots.to: Automated multi-visit data entry and QC agent for research sites (current site)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from differing descriptions

target_customer: Clinical research sites (site owners and directors) running trials
problem: Clinical trials need more skilled staff than the industry has; research sites spend staff time on manual multi-visit data entry and quality control.
business_model: B2B software/AI agent for clinical research sites

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser agent entering data across any EDC (Veeva, Medidata, Oracle logos shown) is moderately hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Little evidence read; workflow integration may create some lock-in.

market_need_then: YC description cites a shortage of skilled clinical trial staff; no dated sources gathered.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly-coworker positioning ('Meet your new favorite coworker'); no external brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Gleam is Active with 4 people. Its current site quotes two site owners and claims 40% more visits per week, but no funding, exit or failure data was found. The product description narrowed from running trials to data-entry automation, though no source dates or explains this.
notes: YC page lists founded 2026, which conflicts with the Summer 2023 batch (likely a data error); founded_year left null. Pivot entry is inferred from description differences, not a sourced statement. Research limit: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before any outcome, funding, competitor or branding search could run, so only the YC page and company site were read; competition_at_founding is left empty (no dated sources), and funding and brand origin facts are unverified or null.
